006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathException;
010
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
013
014/**
015 * Represents an error that occurs during Metapath function evaluation.
016 */
017// TODO: remove this intermediate exception?
018public class FunctionMetapathError
019    extends MetapathException {
020
021  /**
022   * the serial version UID.
023   */
024  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
025
026  /**
027   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with the provided {@code code},
028   * {@code message}, and no cause.
029   *
030   * @param errorCode
031   *          the error code that identifies the type of error
032   * @param message
033   *          the exception message
034   */
035  public FunctionMetapathError(
036      @NonNull IErrorCode errorCode,
037      @Nullable String message) {
038    super(errorCode, message, null);
039  }
040
041  /**
042   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with the provided {@code code},
043   * {@code message}, and {@code cause}.
044   *
045   * @param errorCode
046   *          the error code that identifies the type of error
047   * @param message
048   *          the exception message
049   * @param cause
050   *          the original exception cause
051   */
052  public FunctionMetapathError(
053      @NonNull IErrorCode errorCode,
054      @Nullable String message,
055      @Nullable Throwable cause) {
056    super(errorCode, message, cause);
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Constructs a new Metapath exception with a {@code null} message and the
061   * provided {@code cause}.
062   *
063   * @param errorCode
064   *          the error code that identifies the type of error
065   * @param cause
066   *          the original exception cause
067   */
068  public FunctionMetapathError(
069      @NonNull IErrorCode errorCode,
070      @Nullable Throwable cause) {
071    super(errorCode, null, cause);
072  }
073}
